reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: In the beginning, the app was very nice. It gave you a Hadith every day, more context behind the Hadith and prompt questions. But then, after a certain point, you were unable to see the full daily Hadith. And clicking on it to expand it would shut the app down. Now the app is no longer working. Very disappointed in the direction of the app as I did find it beneficial. Inshallah the creator of this app will work on fixing these bugs so that people can continue to benefit from it.

reviews.title: Not update? Or bug?
reviews.text:
I was intrigued to download this. Esp with the ‘explain hadith’ function. But when i click on it. Nothing happens.. hope it gets fixed..since i like the concept. 

I even paid $4.99. ! I thought it was locked. But still not working! I feel so cheated. Please update or fix it. Its the month of Ramadhan. Was hoping to learn more about the hadith. Im sadden this happen.
